key_idea: Inside a strongly connected component you can collect everything, so condense to a DAG with summed weights and take the heaviest path from comp(0) to comp(N-1).
sketch: Run (iterative) Tarjan to get SCCs; component ids come out in reverse topological order. Sum coins per component and do a DP dp[c] = w[c] + max dp over successors, with dp defined only for components that can reach the component of N-1 (base dp[target]=w[target], others -inf). Process components in increasing Tarjan id so successors are done first; answer dp[comp(0)]. O(N+M). Pitfalls: the path must END at N-1, so a heavier branch that cannot reach it (as in the sample) must be excluded; sums reach 1e14 so use 64-bit; recursion depth 1e5 so use an iterative DFS.
